messages:
mike.sales: Quick handoff — Parliament Health (gov contractor) started an eval today. POC: priya@parliament.health. Trial 30d; renewal window ~60d. Must-have: SAML SSO (gov_id + email), audit webhook delivery, and KMS-backed encryption. They also asked for Private specs. Sharing initial blockers: missing SAML attribute 'gov_id', webhook POSTs returning 500 intermittently, and one sample payload >1MB.

anya.cs: Taking CS ownership. Win criteria: SSO live, webhooks <=1% error, audit latency P95 <250ms, and clear KMS onboarding doc. Do we have repro + contact on the webhook side?

mike.sales: POC confirmed: priya@parliament.health. Uploaded logs in ticket #55421. Sample error: `{"error":"MsgSizeExceeded"}`. Priya prefers Private but will consider Dedicated with VPC peering for cost.

dave.support: Assigned to #55421. Quick triage: our edge proxy currently rejects >1MB posts (limit 1MB). Repro steps + raw payload attached. Short-term ask: request compressed payloads or chunking. Long-term: we can bump proxy limit or implement streaming ingestion.

li.eng: @dave.support @anya.cs I can scope. If we have repro: config change to edge limit = ~24h (hotfix); streaming path ~48-72h. If Private required, note deployment timelines ~3-4 weeks for infra + compliance checks. Need curl repro: ```curl -v -X POST https://audit.parliament/collect -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @payload.json```

zoe.prod: Product note: onboarding docs for gov customers are outdated; multiple KMS flow options confusing. Filing docs ticket and will consolidate a gov checklist.

felix.finance: I'll prepare a two-option price delta (Private one-time + infra vs Dedicated monthly reserved) and post by EOD tomorrow.

anya.cs: Owner matrix: CS=@anya.cs, Support=@dave.support, Eng=@li.eng, Sales=@mike.sales, Finance=@felix.finance, Product=@zoe.prod. Action items: 1) Support attach repro to ticket + confirm exact error times; 2) Eng scope hotfix vs streaming and ETA; 3) CS confirm KMS specifics and required attributes; 4) Finance produce two-option estimate; 5) Sales manage messaging to POC (no promises).

ticket-bot: Ticket #55421 opened by dave.support. SLA flagged 24h. :rotating_light:

anya.cs: Check-in scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT. I'll update with repro status and eng ETA. Thanks all — tagging owners again: @li.eng, @dave.support, @mike.sales, @felix.finance. :thumbsup:
